queries.name: canonical_candidate_tables_with_row_counts
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 300 s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, SUM(CASE WHEN p.index_id IN (0,1) THEN p.rows ELSE 0 END) AS row_count FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id LEFT JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id = t.object_id WHERE t.name NOT LIKE 'Backup[_]%' AND t.name NOT LIKE 'BAK[_]%' AND t.name NOT LIKE '%[_]Backup[_]%' AND t.name NOT LIKE '%[_]BAK[_]%' AND (t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%User%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR t.name LIKE '%Menu%' OR t.name LIKE '%Modulo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR t.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Sucursal%' OR t.name LIKE '%RBAC%') GROUP BY s.name, t.name ORDER BY s.name, t.name

queries.name: canonical_candidate_columns_key_fields
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 500 c.TABLE_SCHEMA, c.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_NAME, c.DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c WHERE c.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE 'Backup[_]%' AND c.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE 'BAK[_]%' AND c.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%[_]Backup[_]%' AND c.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%[_]BAK[_]%' AND (c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Usuario%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%User%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Rol%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Permiso%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Menu%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Modulo%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Empresa%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Unidad%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Sucursal%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%RBAC%') AND (c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Usuario%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%User%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Email%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Correo%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Activo%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Rol%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Permiso%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Menu%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Modulo%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Empresa%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Unidad%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Sucursal%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Ruta%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Codigo%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Nombre%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Requiere%') ORDER BY c.TABLE_SCHEMA, c.TABLE_NAME, c.ORDINAL_POSITION
